feature: PR 133 POSIX controls in UTF-8 paths with payload-bounded RPC pages

behavior.path_components_and_symlink_targets: accept well-formed UTF-8 scalars except U+0000, preserving original bytes without normalization
behavior.unchanged_limits: 255 bytes per component and 4096 bytes per path or symlink target
behavior.strict_metadata_names: volume labels and extended-attribute names continue to reject C0, DEL, and C1 controls
behavior.directory_rpc_pages: validate requested count 1..1024; serialize complete JSON pages and retry from a copied cursor with halved counts until the response plus 4-byte status fits the 1 MiB RPC frame; commit cursor only on success
behavior.diff_rpc_pages: validate requested count 1..64; retry the same stateless revision/path query with halved counts until the response plus 4-byte status fits the 1 MiB RPC frame
behavior.offline_and_namespace_limits: Namespace directory/diff APIs and offline fs-diff retain their entry-count limits; no protocol or storage format change
behavior.oversized_single_entry: fails without advancing a directory cursor; diff reports an error if a one-entry result cannot fit
behavior.json: C0 bytes in paths/names are escaped in JSON and decode to the original bytes

focused_regressions: Directory fs-dir-page and fs-dir-entries pages with 1030 unique 255-byte C0-heavy names: every response fits the frame, all names appear exactly once in sorted order, normal 1024-entry pages remain unchanged, invalid limits do not advance, and EOF/rewind behavior is stable.

RPC fs-diff with 70 unique 4096-byte C0-heavy paths: an overflowing request for 64 returns a smaller complete page, pages match a limit-2 oracle without loss or duplication, cursors advance strictly, repeated requests are stable, EOF repeats, invalid limit 65 fails, and store sequence is unchanged.

baseline_regressions.directory_rpc: failed as expected: RPC payload exceeds 1 MiB
baseline_regressions.revision_diff_rpc: failed as expected: RPC payload exceeds 1 MiB

historical_validation.note: Prior runs are retained as historical evidence; the 79-test run predates PR 133 integration with PR 132. The 81-test directory-only stage preceded the final diff regression and is not current validation.
